title: Business Development Manager (Poland)
description:

Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

• Identify, develop, and manage new business opportunities within the Polish defense sector, with a focus on drone technology and government procurement.

• Collaborate with internal teams (engineering, legal, and finance) to ensure alignment with business objectives.
Negotiate and manage contracts, securing favorable terms and ensuring successful project execution.

Must-Have

• Strong knowledge of the Polish defense ecosystem, including procurement processes and key stakeholders.

• Extroverted personality with excellent communication and networking skills.

• Background in engineering, business, or a related field.

• Strong business acumen and ability to identify strategic opportunities.

• Native Polish speaker with excellent communication skills in English.

• Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Willingness to travel internationally to represent Destinus at key events.

• Experience working with government tenders, procurement processes, or defense technology sales.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in the defense industry.

Who You Are
You are not just a Business Development Manager, an extroverted, strategic thinker with a passion for building high-value partnerships and navigating the complex landscape of defense procurement. You have a deep understanding of the defense ecosystem and know how to navigate procurement processes, build influential relationships, and secure high-value contracts. You excel in high-stakes negotiations, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are driven by the challenge of shaping the future of aerospace and defense technology.
If you want to be at the forefront of UAV defense solutions, working alongside top industry experts and government agencies, we want you on our team.
Benefits

title: Associate Manager, Supply Chain
description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Integrated Supply Chain Manager owns the end-to-end demand-to-delivery cycle for the market, bringing together demand planning/S&OP and logistics/order management into a single point of accountability.

The role supports overall business revenue and profit delivery through rigorous management of demand signals across product and customer channels, and through efficient logistics, fulfilment and order management execution.

The role partners Commercial leadership and works across multi-functional teams - Sales, Marketing, Finance, Logistics and Supply Planning - to assure alignment and sufficiency in the business plans to deliver anticipated demand, while ensuring smooth supply chain operations and best-in-class customer service.

This requires balancing every aspect of the supply chain: managing inventory levels and cost-to-serve, minimizing shortages, and delivering a responsive supply chain through high demand forecast accuracy and OTIF delivery performance, in adherence with global process design and regional/market strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Demand Planning & S&OP

▪ Deliver the Demand Management process: generate a consensus forecast of phased demand at the appropriate planning level on a 12 to 18months horizon, owning enrichment of the forecast to create and publish a consensus.

▪ Execute monthly demand management cycles; co-pilot the commercial leader to drive the Demand Review (DMR) with commercial teams, gain approval of the recommended forecast, and define risks, opportunities and the actions commercial teams will take to drive or influence demand.

▪ Collaborate with statistical modellers on historical data cleansing to ensure data accuracy as a foundation for reliable statistical forecasts, recording all adjustments and assumptions (channel trends, seasonality, promotions).

▪ Analyze multiple variables to shape the demand forecast - shipment/sell-in, POS/sell-out, share, promotional plans, cannibalisation - and collaborate with Sales and Marketing on activity plans and promotional effectiveness.

▪ Own Demand Management KPIs (Mixed Error, Forecast Bias, FVA), leading forecast accuracy improvement plans through root cause analysis and action planning with demand planners, brand and sales teams.

▪ Ensure phased consensus forecast numbers are aligned with financial numbers and proactively communicate demand changes to the regional supply/demand planning organisation, working through service and inventory impacts.

2. Logistics, Fulfilment & Order Management

▪ Formulate, execute and continuously optimise logistics strategy across warehousing, transportation and order fulfilment to ensure On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) delivery.

▪ Oversee day-to-day fulfilment and order management operations - order entry, verification and processing in SAP/ERP - to meet performance, cost-to-serve, warehouse accuracy and inventory turnover targets.

▪ Act as escalation point for customer and sales enquiries on order status, delivery schedules and product availability, partnering with the warehouse and 3PL network to ensure stock availability.

▪ Lead implementation and testing of new order management and logistics systems and process upgrades and maintain SOPs and business continuity/recovery plans.

3. Vendor, Stakeholder & Regional Alignment

▪ Build strong vendor and 3PL partnerships through performance evaluations, service-level negotiations and cost-efficiency initiatives.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - AWS & Salesforce (Poland)
description:
Project Overview: At Flosum , we build the leading native DevOps, Release Management, and Data Backup solutions for the Salesforce ecosystem. While our core platform is native to Salesforce, we utilize a hyperscale, open-cloud architecture on AWS for key web applications and high-throughput background processing.
We are looking for an expert Senior QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain an end-to-end automated testing framework that bridges our AWS cloud web applications and our core Salesforce architecture. This is a mission-critical role where you will ensure the seamless, secure sync of enterprise DevOps data between cloud microservices and Salesforce metadata.
What You Will Do:

• Design and implement an automated testing framework covering both our AWS-hosted web app and our connected Salesforce native workflows.

• Automate end-to-end user journeys that cross platforms (e.g., actions initiated in our cloud web UI that trigger deployments or metadata backups inside Salesforce).

• Create stable UI tests for Salesforce Lightning that resist dynamic ID changes and effectively handle Shadow DOM components (using UTAM, Playwright, or enterprise testing tools).

• Develop robust API automation suites to validate real-time data integrations, webhooks, and secure queues running between AWS and Salesforce.

• Integrate the automated test suites cleanly into modern Git-based CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements
Required Experience & Skills:

•
4+ years in QA Automation Engineering, specifically handling complex enterprise integrations.

•
Deep Salesforce Expertise: Exceptional understanding of Salesforce Lightning architecture, metadata, security models, and developer workflows.

•
Technical Stack: Proficient in code-first automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) OR deep expertise in Salesforce-specific automated testing systems (Provar, ACCELQ, or UTAM framework).

•
API & Database Testing: Expertise in REST API testing and a strong command of SOQL queries for direct Salesforce database verification.

•
DevOps Mindset: Solid experience setting up automated test steps within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or cloud developer tools).

title: Head of Analytics and Business Intelligence
description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on. Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

Analytics at Runpod sits within Data & AI and serves as a strategic partner across the company. The team supports five core areas: marketing and PR; infrastructure and pricing; product; security; and sales. From acquisition and campaign performance to GPU-hour economics, product adoption, fraud detection, and revenue analytics, the team turns Runpod's rich operational data into decisions. This role will lead the established analytics function through its next stage of growth, determining how to staff, sequence, and scale coverage across the business while moving the team from answering questions to helping define the questions Runpod should be asking.

As Head of Analytics and Business Intelligence, you will lead and grow Runpod's analytics function, owning how the company measures itself and how insights reach decision-makers. You will manage a team of analysts and BI practitioners, set the analytics roadmap, and act as the senior analytics partner to Product, Supply, Finance, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market leadership.

Runpod's business is consumption-based and marketplace-shaped, which makes analytics genuinely complex. Demand-side revenue depends on GPU-hour utilization and workload mix across Pods, Serverless, and Instant Clusters, while supply-side economics depend on host behavior, capacity, and pricing. You will build the metric definitions, models, and self-serve layer that allow the company to reason about these dynamics consistently. Our analytics stack includes dbt and Dagster for transformation, Snowflake underneath, and Mode as our BI tool.

You will shape how Runpod uses data to make company-level decisions. You'll have the opportunity to define the metrics that matter, proactively identify business opportunities, build a scalable analytics operating model, and translate complex data into clear recommendations for executives and the board. Success means creating an analytics function that not only responds to the business, but helps lead it.

Responsibilities:

- Lead, coach, and grow a team of analysts and BI practitioners, including hiring, career development, prioritization, and raising the technical bar of the work.

- Drive company strategy proactively from a data perspective by identifying the data levers that can transform the business, quantifying opportunities, and delivering clear paths to action for leadership.

- Own Runpod's core metric layer, defining and maintaining consistent definitions for utilization, retention, net revenue retention, margin, and marketplace supply/demand health.

- Set the analytics roadmap in partnership with Product, Finance, and GTM leadership, balancing recurring reporting needs with deeper analysis that changes decisions.

- Drive analysis of consumption-based revenue and customer behavior, including cohort retention, expansion and churn on usage, savings plan adoption, spot vs. reserved mix, and serverless workload economics.

- Build the self-serve analytics layer so stakeholders can answer routine questions independently, reserving the team's capacity for higher-judgment work.

- Partner closely with Data Engineering on modeling, data quality, freshness, and SOC 2 requirements

description:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future . It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow .
Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

When technology meets medicine, the result is… the Center for Health Engineering (CIS)!
From innovative medical devices (biomechanics, biomaterials, nanoparticles) to digital twins of patients and hospitals, the CIS develops customized solutions to address today’s healthcare challenges.
🧠 Modeling, simulation, collective intelligence: our faculty members work hand in hand with doctors, industry partners, and institutions.
💙 One goal: to improve healthcare and people’s lives through science.

🎯 What we expect from you
As post-doc, you will be at the heart of our missions in research and innovation, assigned to the SAINBIOSE lab. SAINBIOSE (INSERM UMR 1059) brings together researchers from Mines Saint-Etienne (biomechanics, biomaterials and bioengineering), the faculty of Medicine from Jean Monnet University, Saint-Etienne University Hospital, Inserm and the French Blood Establishment. The global scientific objective of SAINBIOSE is a better understanding and of biostress in osteoarticular (LBTO team) and cardiovascular pathology (DVH team). Website: https://sainbiose-lab.fr/
Biomechanics, experimental and computational, is a major research topic of SAINBIOSE, which goes from modelling the mechanical behaviour of tissues to clinical and industrial applications, especially with the textile industry. In 2024, Prof Stéphane Avril and collaborators were awarded a grant from PEPR Digital health to develop a digital twin for patient-specific LVAD [1] solution combining cutting-edge machine learning, advanced simulation, and experimental techniques. This project entitled TwinHeart will take place in a research group having 15 years experience in biomechanics and mechanobiology ( https://emse.fr/~avril/ ).

We open a non-permanent position of post-doctoral fellow to join the Avril’s team working on TwinHeart project. The work will be carried out at Mines Saint-Etienne, within the SAINBIOSE research unit (Inserm U1059). It is based at the Centre Ingénierie et Santé (Hospital campus at the North of Saint-Etienne).

The objective of the post-doctoral fellow will be to develop innovative computational models (multi-scale digital twin, machine learning, growth and remodeling) in which we will calculate the vascular response to LVAD-induced mechanical alterations, particularly the local stiffening of the aortic wall. Previous studies indicate that such stiffening can lead to a significant increase in pulse wave velocity (PWV), which undermines the aorta’s natural cushioning effect. This disruption increases left-ventricular afterload and systolic pressure while reducing coronary perfusion, all of which contribute to adverse cardiovascular remodeling such as left-ventricular hypertrophy and fibrosis recognized risk factors for heart failure progression. SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking an Industrial Pipefitter to support the buildout of SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will install large industrial piping systems and keep construction moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with mechanical, welding, structural, electrical, and operations teams to fit, hang, and test pipe from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXAI data center sites.

• Install large-bore industrial piping (process, mechanical, utility, and related systems): measure, cut, bevel, fit, hang, and make up joints per drawings and specs.

• Report damaged material, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.

• Support punch-list work and cleanup through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years installing large industrial or commercial piping OR completion of a recognized pipefitter apprenticeship, OR equivalent military experience.

• Experience fitting and installing welded, flanged, grooved, and/or threaded pipe, including hangers and supports.

• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.

• Ability to use pipefitting hand tools, power tools, bevelers, and material-handling equipment safely.

• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including LOTO and permits.

• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical construction windows.

• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.

• Experience on large-bore welded industrial piping (carbon and/or stainless) and equipment connections (pumps, air handlers, cooling towers, skids).

• Ability to read isometric, spool, and P&ID drawings.

• UA, NCCER, or equivalent pipefitter credential.

• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.

• Familiarity with hot-work, hydrotest, and flange-management practices.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

title: Patient Coordinator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Organ Health Patient Coordinator (PC) is the primary point of contact and dedicated advocate for patients undergoing organ health genetic testing. This role sits at the heart of Natera's mission - ensuring that every patient is supported, informed, and guided with care through each step of their testing journey. This position will be focused on growing the relationship between Natera and its patients to ensure timely management of testing.  Organ Health patients may require a single test or ongoing, long-term monitoring - in either case, the relationships PCs build are essential, whether that means earning the trust of a new patient to complete their first draw or maintaining continuity with patients throughout a recurring testing journey. A natural drive to overcome objections and convert hesitant patients into confident ones is key to growing the business and ensuring no patient is left behind.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Serve as the patient's dedicated advocate and single point of contact for all things related to their Organ Health testing experience.

• Assess the needs of patients with a focus on customer support, coordination of logistics, and problem solving.

• Set accurate expectations around sample collection scheduling, turnaround time, billing, and next steps to ensure patients feel informed and confident.

• Respond to patient-generated marketing leads and conduct outbound outreach for applicable patient identification and monitoring programs.

• Appropriately triage and escalate complex issues to cross-functional partners including the MP Team, Organ Health Specialists (OHS/Sales), Territory Managers, Customer Experience, and Billing Teams.

• Participate in rotating weekend on-call coverage to ensure urgent patient needs are addressed in a timely manner.

• Maintain and support a service-oriented relationship with patients

• Ensure all data and analysis requests from different parts of the organization are addressed in a timely manner.

• Identify, nurture and grow patient relationships in order to influence and schedule ongoing testing.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

• Adhere strictly to HIPAA regulations, including verifying patient identity on every interaction conducted.

• Employees must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Minimum of 2 years of Call Center experience in an inbound and outbound capacity, patient services, or healthcare customer support role.

• Minimum of 2 years of sales experience 

• Background in medical or biological sciences preferred

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Genuine empathy and compassion; Strong active listening and rapport-building skills with the ability to handle emotionally complex conversations professionally.

• Ability to think strategically as well as execute tactically

• Emphasis on competitive analysis and team first attitude.

• Ability to relate and educate our technology to potential patients

• Comfortable navigating multiple systems and tools simultaneously.

• Self-motivation, with the desire and capacity to work both independently and collaboratively

• Must act with a sense of urgency

• Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, 3D Geometric Vision
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Teams

The Model Foundations team builds the geometric vision and 3D foundation models that underpin Wayve's autonomous driving systems, working at the intersection of large-scale deep learning, geometric computer vision, and real-world robotics to develop models that learn 3D structure and dynamics from fleet-scale sensor data.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Engineer on the Model Foundations team, you will be a hands-on technical leader. You'll set direction for geometric vision, prototype and train new model architectures, build the data and supervision needed to scale them, and take successful ideas through to deployment on real vehicles.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Design and train 3D foundation models and world models using large-scale driving data.

- Develop model architectures for 3D perception, geometric reasoning, reconstruction, and world modeling across space and time.

- Build scalable data generation and auto-labeling pipelines that produce high-quality geometric supervision from large volumes of sensor data.

- Develop and scale offline SLAM and 3D reconstruction systems and pipelines, using large-scale sensor data to recover accurate trajectories, scene geometry, calibration signals, and geometric supervision for model training and evaluation.

- Develop and apply techniques in multi-view geometry, neural rendering, NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting, implicit 3D representations, and feedforward 3D modeling.

- Explore geometry-aware tokenization and representation learning, including efficient ways to encode and fuse information across cameras, viewpoints, time, and sensing modalities.

- Develop foundation vision models that make effective use of camera, radar, LiDAR, and other sensor data for learning rich representations of the physical world.

- Explore video and generative modeling approaches for learning scene structure, dynamics, and future evolution from driving data.

- Train and evaluate models at scale on distributed compute, rapidly iterating on architectures, objectives, data, and training recipes.

- Develop automated evaluation and ground-truth systems for measuring geometric consistency, reconstruction quality, 3D understanding, and downstream driving performance.

- Optimize and deploy models into production autonomous-driving systems, working across model architecture, inference, and onboard constraints.

- Set technical direction for geometric vision at Wayve and work closely with researchers and engineers across foundation models, perception, simulation, data, sensing, and deployment.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

- You have deep expertise in 3D computer vision, geometric vision, or 3D machine learning, with experience in areas such as multi-view geometry, neural rendering, reconstruction, implicit representations, or world modeling.

- You have strong experience designing, training, and evaluating modern deep-learning models at scale, using PyTorch or a comparable framework.

- You have strong mathematical and technical foundations in geometry, linear algebra, probability, optimization, and 3D transformations, combined with excellent software engineering skills in Python and C++.

- You have a track record of taking difficult research problems from idea to working system, including building large-scale data, training, evaluation, or deployment pipelines.

- You bring principal-level technical leadership: the ability to identify high-leverage problems, set research and engineering direction, make strong architectural decisions, and raise the technical bar across teams.

Desirable

- 3D and geometric vision: multi-view geometry, dense 3D reco

title: Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.
description: Kfz-Meister gesucht - vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt. Wir sind autoteam augsburg , eine inhabergeführte Kfz-Meisterwerkstatt in Augsburg-Kriegshaber. Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Fahrzeuge irgendwie durch die Werkstatt zu bekommen. Uns ist wichtig, dass sauber gearbeitet wird, Probleme wirklich gelöst werden und unsere Kunden ihr Fahrzeug mit einem guten Gefühl wieder abholen. Wir arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken und decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Inspektionen nach Herstellervorgaben, Diagnose, Bremsen, Motor, Fahrwerk, Klima, Getriebe, Umbauten und vieles mehr. Gerade deshalb ist der Alltag bei uns abwechslungsreich. Kein Tag ist genau wie der andere und wenn ein Fehler nicht sofort auf der Hand liegt, nehmen wir uns die Zeit, ihn wirklich zu finden. Unsere Werkstatt ist modern und sehr gut ausgestattet. Mehrere Hebebühnen, aktuelle Diagnosetechnik und alles, was man braucht, um ordentlich arbeiten zu können. Gleichzeitig legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass die Werkstatt sauber, gepflegt und ein angenehmer Arbeitsplatz ist. Schließlich verbringt man hier einen großen Teil seines Tages und soll sich auch wohlfühlen. Für unser Team suchen wir einen Kfz-Meister (m/w/d) , der sein Handwerk versteht, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust auf ein Umfeld hat, in dem gute Arbeit geschätzt wird. Was wir dir bieten Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung wirklich einbringen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Entscheidungen mitzutreffen und bei anspruchsvolleren Fällen deine Erfahrung einzusetzen. Du unterstützt unser Team bei Diagnose und Fehlersuche, behältst die Qualität der Arbeiten im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass die Abläufe in der Werkstatt stimmen. title: Kafka Engineer
description:
Kafka Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Kafka Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $82,000-$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Kafka Engineer to architect, deploy, and operate large-scale Apache Kafka and Confluent platform environments supporting mission-critical event-driven workloads. In this role you will own the Kafka platform end-to-end, including cluster sizing, configuration, security, automation, observability, and developer enablement. The ideal candidate will combine deep Kafka internals knowledge with strong DevOps and SRE practices, and will partner with application teams to deliver a reliable, performant, and developer-friendly streaming platform. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of experience operating Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform in production.

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of Kafka internals (partitions, replication, ISRs, consumer groups).

• Strong experience with Kafka security (SASL, mTLS, ACLs, RBAC).

• Hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, and either Kafka Streams or ksqlDB.

• Experience with HA/DR strategies for Kafka.

• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

• Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).

• Working knowledge of observability tooling for Kafka.

• Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Confluent Certified Administrator or Developer credentials.

• Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi, Confluent Operator).

• Exposure to managed Kafka services (AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs Kafka API).

• Familiarity with stream processing frameworks (Flink, Spark Streaming).

• Experience with data governance and lineage for streaming data.

How to Apply

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

We are expanding our senior commercial leadership footprint across the United Kingdom to accelerate growth across Airwallex’s full suite of enterprise solutions-spanning global business accounts, FX & treasury, spend management, global payments, and embedded finance.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Sales (UK), you will serve as a key regional leader driving our generalist enterprise sales motion. In this high-impact, greenfield opportunity, you will own the end-to-end commercial strategy, build top-tier executive relationships, and close multi-product platform deals across the UK market. You will target C-suite decision-makers (CFOs, CTOs, CEOs, and Heads of Ops) at major UK-headquartered multinationals and high-growth global enterprises, while helping shape the broader regional GTM strategy and playbook as we scale.

This role is based in our London office.

What You’ll Be Doing

Regional Market & Pipeline Growth

- Own and execute the UK enterprise sales strategy across all target verticals, driving revenue growth across Airwallex’s full platform product suite.

- Build and manage a robust pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities ($500K+ ARR) through strategic outbound prospecting, executive networks, and partner ecosystems.

- Conduct white-space analysis and strategic account planning to target high-potential UK enterprise accounts with complex global financial needs.

Executive Engagement & Platform Selling

- Build trusted advisor relationships with senior executive buying committees (CFO, Treasurer, CTO, Chief Procurement Officer).

- Deliver compelling, consultative C-level presentations and bespoke business cases that demonstrate the ROI of unifying global financial operations on Airwallex.

- Champion multi-product solution selling, seamlessly positioning business accounts, treasury, card issuing, spend management, and FX alongside core payments.

Deal Orchestration & Commercial Governance

- Lead complex, end-to-end deal negotiations-working cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Risk, and Strategy to structure high-value enterprise agreements.

- Partner with Solutions Engineering, Implementation, and Product to execute tailored proof-of-concepts and ensure frictionless client onboarding.

- Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and pipeline governance in Salesforce to deliver accurate regional forecasting to global leadership.

Regional Leadership & Strategy

- Help define and refine the UK enterprise GTM playbook, sharing market insights and competitive intelligence to influence product roadmaps.

- Act as an ambassador and thought leader for Airwallex in the UK market at industry conferences, customer roundtables, and executive events.

What You Bring

Minimum Qualifications

- 12+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience, including 5+ years of leading enterprise teams.

- Experience managing managers

- Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota on complex, multi-stakeholder

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.

Snowflake is building the future of data and AI. Our public sector partners play a critical role in helping federal agencies modernize their data environments, improve mission outcomes, and deliver better services to constituents.

As Federal Partner Development Manager, you will build and execute joint go-to-market strategies with a portfolio of strategic partners, including Global System Integrators (GSIs), cloud and technology partners, and value-added resellers (VARs). You will align Snowflake and partner sales teams around priority federal accounts, create actionable business plans, and develop programs that generate partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, sales engineering, professional services, product, legal, and marketing to deliver a seamless partner and customer experience. Share partner and customer insights with internal teams to drive continuous improvement, and work with technical experts to build solutions with partners.

- Co-Marketing: Plan and execute co-marketing activities, including events, webinars, and content, to increase partner visibility and generate qualified leads.

- Deal Support: Help partners navigate Snowflake's partner program and sales process, including deal registration, proposal support, and reporting. Align with Sales Leadership and internal teams to keep sales cycles smooth and efficient.

- Performance Delivery: Monitor partner performance against defined metrics, including sourced pipeline, partner activation, and competency growth. Shift priorities, take calculated risks, and think creatively to deliver results while managing multiple priorities at scale.

- Build AI-First Operating Practices: Use Snowflake CoWork, CoCo, Salesforce, Slack, and related tools to streamline partner planning, opportunity tracking, deal registration, executive briefings, and partner scorecards. Identify repeatable workflows that can be automated or augmented with AI, and experiment responsibly to improve speed, visibility, and decision quality. Experience building MCP-based workflows or applying AI to sales and partner operations is a strong plus.

title: Senior Softwareentwickler:in Kotlin/Java (full remote)
description:
wo du mit anpacken kannst

• Als Senior Softwareentwickler:in Kotlin/Java bist Du bei uns der Dreh- und Angelpunkt, wenn es um die Weiterentwicklung unserer Backend-Systeme geht.

• Mit Kotlin, Docker und PostgreSQL baust Du robuste, skalierbare Module, die das Rückgrat unserer medizinischen Software bilden.

• Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team aus Entwicklung, Design, DevOps und Produktmanagement bringst Du komplexe Systeme zum Laufen, denkst Schnittstellen neu und hältst dabei die Code-Qualität hoch.

• Du konzipierst, entwickelst, testest und dokumentierst - immer mit dem Ziel einfache, erweiterbare und nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen.

• Diese Position kann zu 100% aus dem Home-Office ausgeübt werden. Du musst also nicht in Thüringen oder der näheren Umgebung wohnen, um bei uns zu arbeiten, sondern kannst selbst bestimmen, wann Du wo arbeiten willst.

• Einer Teilzeitanstellung steht auch grundsätzlich nichts im Wege, allerdings wäre es ideal, wenn Du wöchentlich mindestens 32h Deiner Zeit mit uns verbringst.

was du mitbringen solltest

• Du hast erfolgreich ein naturwissenschaftliches Studium abgeschlossen (gerne auch Promotion) und kannst auf Dein sehr gutes Ergebnis echt stolz sein.

• Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung, am liebsten mit Kotlin (oder Java), und kennst Dich mit PostgreSQL und containerisierten Architekturen aus.

• Begriffe wie Domain-Driven Design, API-Design und Softwarearchitektur sind für Dich keine Buzzwords, sondern Dein tägliches Werkzeug.

Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at

About the Team
The LexisNexis Risk Solutions Product Support Engineering organization is a global, customer-focused team supporting mission-critical financial crime compliance platforms with the world’s top banking and financial institutions as our customers. The team partners closely with Product Experts, Product Tech and other cross-functional teams to protect service reliability, customer confidence, and continuous product improvement in fast-paced, SLA-driven environments.
About the Role
The Enterprise Support Engineer provides advanced technical support and engineering-level investigation into complex customer-reported production issues. The role combines end-to-end support case ownership with deep troubleshooting across the application, container platform, infrastructure, database, network, identity, messaging, storage, integration, and customer-configuration layers.
This is not a scripted triage position. The Enterprise Support Engineer gathers evidence, recreates customer scenarios, reproduces failures, identifies root causes, validates corrections, and communicates clear findings to customers and internal stakeholders. The engineer manages severity, escalations, and SLA commitments.

• Own assigned customer support cases from intake through resolution, including accurate logging, prioritization, status updates, customer communication, and SLA adherence.

• Troubleshoot Kubernetes and OpenShift resources, including pods, deployments, services, ingress or routes, namespaces, ConfigMaps, secrets, persistent volumes, probes, resource limits, image versions, networking, and scaling behavior.

• Diagnose issues spanning Java web applications, REST APIs, databases, messaging middleware, object storage, authentication and SSO, TLS certificates, cloud infrastructure, and customer integrations.

• Distinguish among product defects, environmental issues, configuration errors, resource constraints, data problems, and integration failures using evidence-based root-cause analysis.

• Correlate logs, metrics, events, traces, timestamps, transaction IDs, request IDs, pod names, service names, configuration, and customer-reported symptoms.

• Perform issue reproduction, hypothesis testing, defect validation, and technical troubleshooting activities.

• Collaborate with internal teams and customers to drive issue resolution and continuous service improvement.

Requirements

• Experience supporting, deploying, implementing, or troubleshooting enterprise web applications, preferably Java-based, in production.

• Working knowledge of Linux or Unix and Windows environments, command-line diagnostics, system outputs, and deployment configuration.

• Understanding of client/server and web application concepts, including HTTP/HTTPS, requests and responses, sessions, cookies, headers, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, connectivity, performance, and timeouts.

• Hands-on experience with, or strong working knowledge of, Kubernetes and/or OpenShift, containers, registries, Helm, externalized configuration, persistent storage, service discovery, probes, resource management, and deployment troubleshooting.

• Understanding of public, private, and hybrid cloud architectures,

Remote Eligibility: Candidates must reside and work full-time in AR, KS, MO, OK, or TX before their first day of employment. Please do not apply if you reside outside these 5 states and will not relocate to one of the approved states listed.

Join a forward-thinking team where your expertise drives quality patient care! We are looking for a detail-oriented Professional Medical Coder to help streamline our charge review coding workflow for Adult and Pediatric Evaluation and Management services and Minor Procedures, resolve denials and work with leadership to put processes in place to reduce denials. Enjoy flexible remote / hybrid options, continuous career development, and competitive compensation in a supportive environment.

General Description
Independently performs complex professional coding across multiple specialties and settings, including office/clinic, hospital outpatient, ED/urgent care, ASC, SNF/nursing home, and telehealth. Applies advanced coding judgment, payer policy interpretation, and documentation standards to support compliant reimbursement, wRVU integrity, and audit defensibility in an academic and research enterprise.

Essential Job Duties
Responsibilities listed in this section are core to the position. Inability to perform these responsibilities, with or without an accommodation, may result in disqualification from the position.

• Code complex professional encounters and procedures; ensure correct sequencing, modifiers, E/M level selection, and documentation alignment. Advanced expertise in ICD‑10‑CM, CPT®, HCPCS, and modifiers; strong E/M coding proficiency and payer policy interpretation.

• Resolve coding-related edits and denials by identifying root cause, coordinating documentation clarification, and supporting rebilling actions as applicable.

• Apply payer medical policies, NCCI concepts, global service considerations, and telehealth coding rules as relevant to pro fee claims.

• Provide real‑time guidance to peers on standard coding scenarios; promote consistency through best‑practice sharing.

• Participate in internal quality review programs and implement education/corrective actions based on findings.

• Proficiency in Epic professional coding work queues and encoder tools; ability to efficiently review documentation in the EHR across settings.

• Analytical problem solving for denial/edits prevention; ability to identify documentation improvement opportunities and support compliant query workflows

• Working knowledge of risk adjustment concepts and HCC validation where applicable to supported populations.

General Job Duties

• Performs other duties as assigned
Education: High School diploma or GED required.
Experience: At least 3 years of experience physician/provider coding required.
Certification/License/Registration : RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CPC, or CIC required.
